turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on eat and drink?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you how I find a food word from a clue. The clue: it is yellow and long, and monkeys love it. I think: what food is yellow and long? A banana. I spell it: b-a-n-a-n-a. Then I use it: "A monkey eats a banana."
One thing to watch: we say eat soup. Right: "eat soup" Wrong: "drink soup".
Now you try. Read the clue and write the word:
Write the word: you drink it, it is white. ___
